name: Mannō (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Mannō town emblem in white: a disc with a blue comma-shaped swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Mannō, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Mannō town emblem — a disc with a blue comma-shaped swirl
